name: diff-tool-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-diff-tool — a headless core.nav contribution (keeps the app's own WS open so a diff_open event, from either entry point, opens a window) plus every open diff's floating window body (core.window.body:diff.viewer, one instance per diff id via the 2026-08-05 dynamic-window framework addition). src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
